attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory permissions on node1 (created inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group, set ownership and 750/640 modes so only inventorysvc/group members can access it, others get nothing), preserving all existing data. Verified access control with temporary test users (reader in group could read, outsider was denied), then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed the boot_id changed after reconnecting, and reverified ownership, permissions, and full data contents post-restart.
